findings: Changes requested (needs owner ruling, R4 and decision 0014): the completeness precondition is turned on by a side effect. In anvil/runner.py, _run_pipeline sets completeness_active = any(station_budget_settings(config)), so whether reviewers can be launched on an incomplete attempt depends on whether the project configured token partitions. Token partitioning (R1 to R3) and completeness (R4) are separate concerns with separate failure modes, and the spec states R4 with no condition. Decision 0014 records the scoping honestly and gives the cause: running it everywhere breaks 22 protected scripted tests. That makes it a guardrail conflict the line cannot resolve itself. The owner should either amend R4 to make completeness opt-in, ideally through its own explicit switch rather than through budget keys, or authorize updating the 22 tests so completeness runs unconditionally. This matches the reviewer-spec finding.

Fit with decisions passes: decision 0014 follows the house format (context, decision, consequences) and states the trade-off: a partition sized too small now ends the run at that station. It builds on 0011 (station timeout: same kill-and-record shape, timeout keys unchanged) and 0013 (continuous run accounting: refusals and ceiling kills go through _station_stop and the existing exit_status budget_exceeded path, with no second way of ending a run). max_run_tokens stays the outer bound (token-efficiency R4), and validate_station_budgets checks partitions against it.

Boundaries pass: config.py owns parsing and validation (station_budget_settings, pipeline_partitions, validate_station_budgets), and it fails closed, raising ValueError on bad ids, non-positive or bool values, and over-cap worst cases, naming the excess. telemetry.py owns consumption arithmetic (station_consumption, precall_decision are pure, read existing per-attempt usage records, never treat unmeasured as zero). completeness_gaps in runner.py is a pure read-only function that consumes the gate verdict and existing deltas, re-runs no suite and does not repeat the artifact contract's literal validation. The checks gate's verdict and S4 behavior are not modified; completeness only sets gate_failed alongside it.

Config separation passes: the new keys live inside efficiency; the top-level station_budgets (packet size, get_station_budget) is untouched, and docs/EXECUTION.md names both keys and explains the difference. anvil.yaml ships the corrected table, which sums to 15000000. No new dependency (signal, threading are standard library). No en dash or em dash characters in the changed or new files.

Nit, second source of truth: anvil/config.py adds MODEL_CALLING_DETERMINISTIC {intake} and DETERMINISTIC_FALLBACK {approver, triage-human, checks-gate}. anvil/runner.py already hardcodes the fallback set {intake, approver, triage-human} inline in two places (the kind fallback near line 2038 and is_agent near line 3029). The two copies disagree on intake and checks-gate. Prefer one helper (config.is_model_station) that the runner also uses, in a later order if not this one.

Nit, string coupling across the wrapper boundary: the refusal of a correction reaches the runner as stderr text, matched by substring on CORRECTION_REFUSED, which is duplicated in tools/claude_station.py and anvil/runner.py with a SYNC comment. The in-flight kill instead goes through the structured usage-attempt record (status budget_exceeded, read by executor.py). Recording the correction refusal the same structured way, or matching on the dedicated exit code 12, would remove the duplicated literal. This follows an existing SYNC pattern in the repo, so it is not a blocker.

Nit, function size: _run_pipeline gains about 300 lines, including three closures (budgets_view, cost_stations_view, precall) and the step_ceiling handling, which is duplicated in the intake and main executor except-branches the same way the timeout handling is. budgets_view and cost_stations_view are pure over (steps, partitions, price_table) and could live in telemetry.py beside station_consumption, which would make them testable without a run harness. This is not required for this order.
